This message comes from Schwab. At Schwab, you can get everything from self-directed investing to full-service wealth management, all in one place.
No matter your investing goal, life stage, amount to invest, or know-how, you can invest your way with Schwab.
They're grieving the deaths of three children and a teacher during a shooting this week in an elementary school.
Mayor Melanie Keebler said news of the shooting was a call no public official ever wants to receive.
It is just an incredible and profound moment of grief and overwhelm for people. It's hard to process these kinds of things.
It's unfathomable that people would lose their children in this manner when schools are supposed to be a place where people can teach our children and they can feel safe.
The shooter was killed by a parent. Police say the 16-year-old was a special needs student who had once attended the school where the shooting took place.
A fast-moving fire in Southern California is destroying expensive coastal properties in Orange County.
At least six homes were destroyed on Friday, and some 16,000 residents were ordered to evacuate their properties.
The Norte Fire began in the coastal city of San Clemente, but has quickly made its way to San Juan Capistrano.
A new congressional report says President Trump's stockholdings in pharmaceutical companies have grown dramatically, and Piers Sydney-Lupkin reports.
Minority members on the Joint Economic Committee issued a report Friday that says the president's stockholdings in pharmaceutical companies were worth as much as $56.2 million in 2025.
That's up from as much as $1.7 million in 2024. The report is based on the president's annual financial disclosures.
Those documents offer ranges but not exact dollar amounts for each stock.
The report shows significant increases in the president's holdings in Johnson & Johnson, Merck, Eli Lilly, and others.
The president's wealth overall has grown significantly in his second term, NPR reporting has found.
Sydney-Lupkin, NPR News.
New York Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez is transferring $1 million from her campaign to support Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed.
As M.Piers Elena Moore reports, the Michigan Democrat is locked in one of the most competitive matchups of the midterms.
Ocasio-Cortez made the announcement while campaigning alongside El-Sayed in Michigan.
The only reason I'm doing that is because I see the energy of each and every one of you all stepping up to make an effort.
And you all need support. And so when you all step up, the cavalry is coming.
The congresswoman is a longtime ally of El-Sayed and backed him in the Democratic primary when many state and federal party leaders didn't.
It comes amid wide speculation about Ocasio-Cortez's political future.
She's a prominent leader of her party's leftmost flank and is seen as a potential 2028 presidential candidate.
Elena Moore, NPR News.
Stocks closed down on Wall Street Friday.
The NASDAQ was down 2.1 percent and posted its first weekly loss since June.
The Dow Jones industrial is down by three tenths of a percent.
This is NPR News.
Kenya's health official is confirming that a third person has tested positive for Ebola.
The 65-year-old woman was in quarantine.
She's a relative of the 40-year-old man who died from Ebola on October 5th.
The second patient is a 39-year-old man from the same family who remains in stable condition.
El Nino's effects are being felt on the West Coast.
Communities are reeling from coastal flooding across Southern California and parts of the Bay Area.
Ezra David Romero, member station KQED explains.
Scientists say the recent flooding is partly due to what they call a Kelvin wave.
But this massive wave isn't visible like a tsunami.
It moves slowly beneath the ocean's surface and is one of the first effects of El Nino,
where warm ocean water sloshes eastward.
Dylan Amaya studies marine extremes at North Carolina State University.
This is not totally unexpected, but we expect five, maybe six of these coastally trapped waves
over the life of the El Nino event into the winter.
Kelvin waves can temporarily raise sea levels by several inches to more than a foot and trigger minor flooding.
Scientists say another Kelvin wave is crawling up the Mexico coast
and could reach California in the coming weeks.
For NPR News, I'm Ezra David Romero in San Francisco.
Washington broke a three-game losing streak Friday night with a 38-26 win over Purdue.
Elijah Brown threw for three touchdowns and 302 yards in the win.
Tulane had an easy time with Memphis, winning 31-17.
Abb State beat Coastal Carolina 35-32.
And the Columbia Lions hung on to beat the Penn Quakers 28-27 in an Ivy League brawl.
I'm Dale Willman, NPR News.
